U2: OOTB gpfdist sink module for fast data movement into GPDB/HAWQ. gpfdist is a file-based data loading tool for Greenplum. Need to create a sink module.
U3: Setup UI infrastructure for admin_ui and Flo. Likely setting up a frontend project structure, maybe Angular/React, integrating with backend.
U4: End-to-end Kafka use-case for study/demo. This is a test/demo scenario, not a feature. May involve creating sample apps, configuration, tests.
U5: Efficient file reading - tasklet approach vs stream. This is a design inquiry, but as a developer, implement a tasklet for file reading? Possibly implement a file reading tasklet that reads efficiently.
U6: Create gpload tasklet for data ingestion into GPDB. gpload is a Greenplum utility. Need to create a Spring Batch tasklet.
U7: Remove Hadoop dependencies from root classpath. Modularize dependencies so that Hadoop jars are loaded only when needed.
U8: Add support for dynamic classpath for modules. Allow loading dependencies based on module options or properties.

Effort: 5 days (moderate complexity, multiple components)

- This is a demo/example. Need to create sample code, configuration, documentation, and possibly a test suite. Effort: 2 days

- Design and implement a tasklet that reads files efficiently, using buffered streams, possibly using partitioning. Write tests. Effort: 3 days

Activity 6: Implement gpload tasklet (U6)
- Create a Spring Batch tasklet that invokes gpload utility. Handle arguments, error handling, tests. Effort: 4 days

- Refactor module loading to make Hadoop optional. Extract Hadoop-specific code into separate module, adjust classpath configuration, ensure backward compatibility. Effort: 5 days (complex, many dependencies)

- Implement logic to load dependencies from configurable locations based on module options or properties. Modify module loading mechanism. Write tests. Effort: 6 days (complex, involves classloader manipulation)

technical_and_design_decisions: Use the existing Spring XD/Spring Cloud Data Flow module system as the base.
For U1, define Encoder and Decoder interfaces and a plugin mechanism for customization.
For U2, implement gpfdist sink module using the gpfdist HTTP interface or embed the gpfdist client library.
For U3, set up UI infrastructure using Angular or React for the frontend and integrate with the existing backend API.
For U4, create a sample end-to-end Kafka application using Spring Integration Kafka binder and Spring XD streams.
For U5, implement a Spring Batch tasklet that reads files using buffered I/O and supports large file handling.
For U6, implement a gpload tasklet that invokes the gpload command-line tool with appropriate parameters.
For U7, modularize Hadoop dependencies by extracting them into separate Maven modules and using optional dependencies or classpath isolation.
For U8, implement dynamic classpath loading using URLClassLoader with configurable paths based on module options or properties.
assumptions: The target codebase is Spring XD (or Spring Cloud Data Flow) with an existing module and plugin architecture.
The development team is familiar with Spring Framework, Kafka, Greenplum, and related tools.
A build system (Maven/Gradle) and continuous integration pipeline are already in place.
Unit and integration testing frameworks (JUnit, Spring Boot test) are available.
The UI infrastructure for admin_ui and Flo is being set up from scratch but follows existing patterns.
gpfdist and gpload utilities are available on the deployment environment.
Hadoop dependencies are currently included in the root classpath and need to be isolated.
Dynamic classpath support should allow loading from local file system paths specified in module options or properties.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement plugin interfaces for encoders and decoders, modify Kafka source, sink, and bus to support customization, add configuration options, and write unit/integration tests.
Create a new sink module that uses gpfdist to load data into GPDB/HAWQ, handle configuration, error handling, and provide tests.
Set up frontend project structure, build configuration, integrate admin_ui and Flo components, and establish API communication with the backend.
Develop sample applications, configuration files, and documentation demonstrating Kafka integration with Spring XD, including performance and scalability verification.
Design and implement a Spring Batch tasklet that reads files using buffered streams, supports large files, and compares tasklet vs stream approach. Write tests.
Implement a Spring Batch tasklet that invokes the gpload command-line tool to ingest data into GPDB, with proper argument passing and error handling.
